query: I planted some new cherry tomato seedlings on my balcony yesterday, and I’m so excited to watch them grow— I even bought a little mini watering can that fits perfectly in the corner of the shelf next to them. This morning I noticed a tiny ladybug crawling on one of the leaves, it was bright red with those classic black spots, I hope it sticks around to eat any aphids that might pop up later. Oh and I was also baking chocolate chip cookies last night, I accidentally added a little extra sea salt on top of half the batch and they turned out way better than the regular ones, I’m definitely making that mistake again next time. Anyway, I’m having a bunch of issues with my phone right now: the network connection is really bad, my Wi-Fi calling won’t work at all, my MMS messages won’t send I think my APN settings are messed up, some of my apps are crashing because they can’t access their storage, my mobile data mode is toggled off right now I can’t even turn it back on, I got a notification that I’ve exceeded my data usage limit, and I keep getting an error saying my SIM card isn’t detected so I think it might have come unseated.
